name: Ordelo
description:
## About Ordelo

Ordelo is a ready-to-sell digital commerce and ordering package for restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, retailers, creators, and new entrepreneurs who want to stop losing orders to WhatsApp chaos, napkin menus, and “wait, did they pay?” moments.

### No paper trail. No guessing.

Customers browse → customize → pay → track. Staff see orders land in real time. You see numbers that actually mean something. Everyone gets notified on the spot.

### More than a menu website

Sell Ordelo as a restaurant ordering system, multi-location brand hub, cloud kitchen command center, reservation + ordering combo, creator shop, subscription club, retail mini-store, or automation machine — one customer package with many futures.

features.title: Branded Ordering Storefront
features.description: Mobile-first menu and catalog with customization, cart, and checkout — your name on the order, not a marketplace’s.

features.title: Kitchen & Ops Calm
features.description: Kitchen display, live status flow, busy mode, and assignment — orders land where work happens, not buried in a phone.

features.title: Notified on the Spot
features.description: Confirmation and status updates the moment something changes — received → preparing → ready → completed.

features.title: Delivery, Pickup & Dine-In
features.description: Fulfillment modes the business actually runs — plus reservations, multi-location hours, and delivery hooks when you need wheels.

features.title: Payments & Coupons
features.description: Clear checkout, configurable payment methods, campaign codes, and accounting-friendly exports — not cash-in-a-jar folklore.

features.title: Reports That Don’t Lie
features.description: Orders over time, top items, coupon performance, location comparisons, and visitor insights you can act on.

features.title: Automations & Webhooks
features.description: New order → kitchen + customer. Status change → SMS. Busy mode → pause checkout. Connect CRM, Slack, and partners.

features.title: Grow Beyond Food
features.description: Digital products, gift vouchers, subscriptions, memberships, and social campaign pages — same customers, more revenue lanes.

testimonials.quote: You didn’t start a business to become a full-time message router. Ordelo turns chat chaos into clean orders.
testimonials.author: Ordelo promise

faq.question: Isn’t this just another menu website?
faq.answer: No. Ordelo is ordering HQ: cart, payments, kitchen display, notifications, reports, and room to grow into subscriptions and digital products — not a brochure with a phone number.

faq.question: We already get orders on WhatsApp. Why switch?
faq.answer: WhatsApp is a chat. Ordelo is a record. Every order lands in one place, the kitchen sees it, the customer gets updates on the spot, and you keep the customer relationship.

faq.question: Won’t customers just use food apps?
faq.answer: They might discover you there. Ordelo is how you stop renting every order — your storefront, your margins, your data.

faq.question: We’re a small café / new brand. Is this overkill?
faq.answer: Launch like a brand on day one. Start with menu, checkout, and notifications. Add kitchen display, multi-location, subscriptions, and automations when you’re ready.

faq.question: Can it handle kitchen rush and multi-branch?
faq.answer: Yes. Busy mode pauses checkout gracefully, kitchen display keeps status clear, and Scale tiers add multi-location menus, hours, and branch reporting.

faq.question: Can we sell more than food?
faq.answer: Yes. Digital downloads, gift vouchers, meal plans, coffee clubs, VIP memberships, and campaign landing pages — same customer relationship, more revenue lanes.
